summary: Shows the page's position in the hierarchy and lets users navigate back up to parent levels.
whenToUse: Deep hierarchical structures (sections, subsections, detail pages).
whenNotToUse: Flat sites with a single level.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Beyond this number, the middle items are collapsed into an expandable “…” button.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem: href
props.description: Destination. Without href, the item is the current page.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem: linkProps
props.description: Props for the inner link (routerOptions, target…).

keyboard.action: Moves through the links and the expand button.

accessibility: nav landmark with an ordered list.
The current page has aria-current="page" and is not a link.
Separators are decorative (aria-hidden) and are mirrored in RTL.
responsive: Items wrap; with maxItems the trail stays short on mobile.
customization: Colors: text.secondary for links, text.primary for the current page.
commonMistakes: Making the current page a link to itself.
Using the breadcrumb as the only navigation on mobile.

examples.name: FolderNavigation
examples.title: Stateful folder navigation
examples.description: The path is kept in state: linkProps.onPress goes back to a parent folder, and the buttons open subfolders.

examples.name: LongLabels
examples.title: Long labels and current page with href
examples.description: Long items wrap in a narrow container; isCurrent makes the last item the current page even with href.
